title: File an income tax return
description: A return under section 114, filed on IRIS.

questions.prompt: Are you on the Active Taxpayers List?
questions.prompt_ru: Kya aap Active Taxpayers List par hain?

steps.title: Read who must file
steps.detail: Section 114 of the Income Tax Ordinance, 2001 says who files a return of income.

steps.title: Prepare the wealth statement if it applies
steps.detail: Section 116 covers the wealth statement that is filed with many returns.

steps.title: File on IRIS
steps.detail: Submit the return on IRIS before the date notified for that tax year.
